Privacy Policy

Last Updated: May 2026

At ClarifyPost, accessible from https://clarifypost.dippan.com.np, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by ClarifyPost and how we use it.

Log Files

ClarifyPost follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. The information collected includes internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks.

Google AdSense and Cookies

Google is one of a third-party vendor on our site. It also uses cookies, known as DART cookies, to serve ads to our site visitors based upon their visit to our site and other sites on the internet. You may choose to decline the use of DART cookies by visiting the Google ad and content network Privacy Policy at the following URL – https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads

Google Analytics

We use Google Analytics 4 to monitor and analyze web traffic. Google Analytics is a web analytics service offered by Google that tracks and reports website traffic. Google uses the data collected to track and monitor the use of our Service.

Consent

By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
